appearance.previewCaption: Every change applies at once, everywhere.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.adjusted: Adjusted to stay readable: {{text}} for text, {{fill}} for buttons.

followArtwork.label: Follow artwork colour
followArtwork.description: The accent takes the colour of the artwork on screen or playing.

transparency.label: Transparency
transparency.description: Blur and translucency of the chrome. 0 is solid.

density.label: Density
density.description: Spacing and rows, on top of the style’s own.

sidebar.label: Sidebar
sidebar.autoHideHint: Point at the left edge of the window to show it.

backdrop.label: Artwork backdrop
backdrop.description: The page’s artwork, blurred behind the interface.

motion.label: Motion
motion.description: Reduced also follows the system setting.

reset.label: Reset to Style Defaults
reset.description: Brings every option above back to what {{style}} uses.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: The signature look: balanced, airy and familiar.

glass.name: Glass
glass.description: Translucent, light-catching layers that float over a soft glow.

cinema.name: Cinema
cinema.description: Immersive: the artwork you are viewing tints the whole interface.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.description: Pure and typographic: flat surfaces, hairlines and quiet colour.

compact.name: Compact
compact.description: Dense rows and smaller artwork, made for large libraries.

servers.emptyMessage: Add a Jellyfin server to start watching and listening.
servers.removeMessage: You will be signed out of this server on this device. Your media stays on the server.
servers.storageWarning: Sign-in tokens cannot be encrypted on this computer, so they are kept in memory only: you will need to sign in again after restarting Orphyn.
servers.removeFailed: The server could not be removed.

playback.maxBitrateFooter: Lower this on a slow connection. Jellyfin will transcode what exceeds it.
playback.autoPlayNextDescription: When an episode ends, the next one starts after a short countdown.

music.crossfadeDescription: Blend the end of a song into the next one. Coming soon.
music.qualityFooter: Original plays the file as stored. A bitrate asks the server to transcode, which saves data.

about.jellyfinDescription: The free software media system behind your library
about.notEncryptedLinux: Memory only: no keyring found. Install and unlock GNOME Keyring or KWallet to keep your sign-in
about.autoUpdateDescription: Check for a new version at launch and every few hours.

status.ready: Orphyn {{version}} is ready. Restart to update
status.unsupported: Updates are only checked in installed builds

discord.footer: Orphyn shows what you play in your Discord status. Nothing is sent when it is off.
discord.enabled: Show what I am playing on Discord
discord.enabledDescription: Music appears as Listening to Orphyn, videos as Watching Orphyn.
discord.notConfiguredNote: Discord is not set up in this build, so nothing is shown yet.
discord.artworkDescription: The artwork link points to your server, so it only works when the server is reachable over public HTTPS. Otherwise the Orphyn logo is shown.
discord.unavailable: Discord is only available in the desktop app.
